quotes.ambiguity_defined_on_unlabeled_data: The ambiguity is defined as the variation of the output of ensemble members averaged over unlabeled data, so it quantifies the disagreement among the networks.
quotes.only_useful_if_they_disagree: A combination of the output of several networks (or other predictors) is only useful if they disagree on some inputs.
quotes.variance_about_the_weighted_mean: It is simply the variance of the weighted ensemble around the weighed mean, and it measures the disagreement among the networks on input x.
quotes.constraint_on_the_sum_is_crucial: constrain the weights to be positive and sum to one. The constraint on the sum is crucial for some of the following results.

citation: Krogh & Vedelsby, NIPS 1994, Neural Network Ensembles, Cross Validation, and Active Learning
